screens.title: Banner, old helper removal cancelled
screens.when: The administrator dialog was cancelled.

screens.title: Banner, finish an interrupted import
screens.when: After onboarding, an earlier import from LockPlus 1.x didn't finish (E2E-5 F4).

screens.title: Banner, open LockPlus at login instead of the old app
screens.when: LockPlus 1.0.x's LaunchAgent was removed at launch (E2E-5 F5).

screens.title: Pause confirmation
screens.when: After choosing 5 min / 15 min / 1 hour.

screens.title: Pause confirmation, background item not allowed
screens.when: Resume on time needs the login item.

screens.title: Error details
screens.when: Details... on an error.

screens.title: Alert, switch to a profile without kill switch (stand-in)
screens.when: Active profile has kill switch, target doesn't. (Native alert; drawn from the app's strings.)

screens.title: Alert, pause protection (menu) (stand-in)
screens.when: Pause from the menu. (Native alert; drawn from the app's strings.)

screens.title: Refusal, old helper refuses connect (strip, no alert sheet)
screens.when: Connect while the old helper's tunnel or kill switch is up. A strip above the detail, so Quit isn't blocked (E2E-5 F8).

screens.title: Confirmation, delete profile (stand-in)
screens.when: Delete... (Native alert; drawn from the app's strings.)

screens.title: Alert, remove locked profiles (stand-in)
screens.when: Remove Locked Profiles... (Native alert; drawn from the app's strings.)

screens.title: Alert, start over (stand-in)
screens.when: Re-import... on locked profiles. (Native alert; drawn from the app's strings.)

screens.when: Reference of all eight states.

screens.when: Shipping since UI-CONCEPT draft 8.4 (owner pick p2). Every state in the menu bar (mono 15 pt and colour tile 13 pt, with and without rates, @1x/@2x pixels at 15 and 13 pt), 40 pt family, menu header and hero.
